articles.headline: Ranking the 2026 World Cup's best viral moments, from Merlin the Duck to the Viking Row
articles.description: Forget the football! These meme-worthy moments helped make the 2026 FIFA World Cup one of the most memorable in history.

articles.headline: Marc Cucurella: I need to get World Cup tattoo of Luis de la Fuente's face 'somewhere visible'
articles.description: Spain defender Marc Cucurella has said his planned tattoo of coach Luis de la Fuente's face to honour the nation's World Cup win "has to be somewhere visible" on his body.

articles.headline: Unai Simón on Spain's World Cup defence: 'I didn't have to work that hard'
articles.description: After cruising through the World Cup barely allowing any goals, Spain won the final hardly allowing a shot.

articles.headline: Argentina FA president pays tribute to Lionel Messi: 'A story that will live forever'
articles.description: Argentina Football Association president Claudio Tapia paid a glowing tribute to captain Lionel Messi for his outstanding contribution to the national team.

articles.headline: Rodri reflects on path from ACL tear to World Cup glory: I want to thank myself
articles.description: Rodri hopes to have inspired others to "rise again" having fought back from a significant knee injury to captain Spain to World Cup glory.
